description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Create' feature for articles within a web application. It defines data models, validation logic, command handling, and database interaction logic to create a new article with associated tags.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Container class for article creation feature, including nested data models, validators, command, handler, and envelope.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article details such as Title, Description, Body, and TagList.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validation class for ArticleData to enforce non-null and non-empty constraints.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating the ArticleData, implements IRequest to be handled by MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for Command objects, ensuring Article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of an article, including author retrieval, tag processing, and saving to the database.

methods.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator.Constructor
methods.description: Sets validation rules to ensure Title, Description, and Body are not null or empty.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of creating a new article, linking author, processing tags, and saving all to the database.
